Just-in-time compilation

Source: R/dispatch.R
jit.Rd

Port of jax.jit. The function is traced once per combination of argument shapes, dtypes, weak types, pytree structure and static arguments, lowered to StableHLO and compiled by XLA. Under other transformations (grad, vmap, ...) the cached jaxpr is evaluated under the active transformation.

Usage

jit(
  fun,
  static_argnums = NULL,
  static_argnames = NULL,
  donate_argnums = integer(0),
  inline = FALSE
)

Arguments

fun

Function of arrays (or pytrees of arrays).

static_argnums

0-based positions of arguments treated as compile time constants (negative positions count from the end). Static values are compared with identical(), so two closures are the same static argument only when they are the same function with the same environment.

static_argnames

Names of arguments treated as static. As in JAX, when only one of static_argnums and static_argnames is given the other is inferred from the parameters of fun, so a static parameter is static however it is passed.

donate_argnums

Accepted for compatibility; ignored.

inline

Ignored.

Value

The compiled function.
